```artifact
Feature: Doctor Management

  Scenario: Add a new Doctor
    Given a new Doctor with name "John Doe", age 30, sex "Male", qualification "MBBS", experience 5, speciality "Cardiology"
    When I add the Doctor to the system
    Then the Doctor is added successfully
    And the Doctor's details are displayed correctly

  Scenario: View and Update Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with name "Jane Doe", age 25, sex "Female", qualification "MBBS", experience 3, speciality "Pediatrics"
    When I view the Doctor's details
    Then the Doctor's details are displayed correctly
    When I update the Doctor's details
    Then the Doctor's details are updated successfully
    And the Doctor's speciality remains the same

  Scenario: Delete Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with name "Bob Smith", age 40, sex "Male", qualification "MBBS", experience 10, speciality "Cardiology"
    And no new Patient Consultation Request is pending
    When I delete the Doctor's details
    Then the Doctor's details are deleted successfully

  Scenario: Maintain Chemist & Labs
    Given a Chemist with name "Chemist 1", pincode "123456", address "Address 1"
    When I add the Chemist to the system
    Then the Chemist is added successfully
    And the Chemist's details are displayed correctly

  Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
    Given a Lab with name "Lab 1", pincode "123456", address "Address 1"
    When I add the Lab to the system
    Then the Lab is added successfully
    And there is only one Lab in the pincode

  Scenario: View and Update Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with name "Chemist 2", pincode "123456", address "Address 2"
    When I view the Chemist's details
    Then the Chemist's details are displayed correctly
    When I update the Chemist's details
    Then the Chemist's details are updated successfully
    And the Chemist's pincode remains the same

  Scenario: Delete Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with name "Chemist 3", pincode "123456", address "Address 3"
    And no new Prescription is pending
    When I delete the Chemist's details
    Then the Chemist's details are deleted successfully

  Scenario Outline: Add a new Doctor with invalid details
    Given a new Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", speciality "<speciality>"
    When I add the Doctor to the system
    Then an error message is displayed

    Examples:
      | name | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality |
      | ""  | 0   | "" | ""           | 0          | ""        |
      | "a" | 100 | "b" | "c"          | 100        | "d"       |

  Scenario Outline: Add a new Chemist or Lab with invalid details
    Given a Chemist with name "<name>", pincode "<pincode>", address "<address>"
    When I add the Chemist to the system
    Then an error message is displayed

    Examples:
      | name | pincode | address |
      | ""  | 0       | ""     |
      | "a" | 100     | "b"    |

  Scenario Outline: Delete Doctor Details with pending Patient Consultation Request
    Given a Doctor with name "<name>", age "<age>", sex "<sex>", qualification "<qualification>", experience "<experience>", speciality "<speciality>"
    And a new Patient Consultation Request is pending
    When I delete the Doctor's details
    Then an error message is displayed

    Examples:
      | name | age | sex | qualification | experience | speciality |
      | "a"  | 0   | "b" | "c"          | 0          | "d"       |

  Scenario Outline: Delete Chemist/Lab Details with pending Prescription
    Given a Chemist with name "<name>", pincode "<pincode>", address "<address>"
    And a new Prescription is pending
    When I delete the Chemist's details
    Then an error message is displayed

    Examples:
      | name | pincode | address |
      | "a"  | 0       | "b"    |
```
